text: ZX Bank offers flexible Gold Loans, providing customers with quick access to funds using their gold jewelry as collateral. Our Gold Loan products are designed for individuals seeking instant liquidity for business needs, emergencies, education, or any personal requirement.

- Fast Processing: Walk-in disbursal, minimal paperwork, and instant approval.
- Secure Storage: Your gold jewelry is stored securely in bank vaults.
- Flexible Repayment: Choice of tenure and repayment options.
- Digital Tracking: Manage and repay your loan via the ZX Bank Asia Mobile App.
path: ZX Bank Gold Loan > Features of ZX Bank Gold Loan

locations.heading: Features of ZX Bank Gold Loan

text:
- Starting Rate: 9.5% per annum (floating, subject to change as per prevailing bank rates and loan tenure)
- Processing Fee: 0.25% of the loan amount or ₹250 (whichever is higher)
Note: Actual interest rate may vary based on gold purity, market rates, and loan amount.
path: ZX Bank Gold Loan > Interest Rate

text:
- Up to ₹50 lakhs (India)
- Other countries (Sri Lanka, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh): Equivalent local currency up to bank specified regulatory maximum
- Loan-to-Value (LTV): Up to 75% of the gold's market value, as per RBI regulations
